title: The summer in one window
logline: The bookstore's window at the end of August: the zines, the eye sign's reflection from across the street, a crow on the sill, a girl's bicycle leaning below, and in the glass a man in plaid from behind with an old dog — the whole other story and the strip's own in one pane. The sequence ends on the glass.

panels.composition: A bookstore window holding stapled zines, reflecting a hand-painted eye sign from across the street, a crow on the sill and a bicycle leaning below, and in the glass the reflection of a man in plaid from behind with an old three-legged dog.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bookstore window holding small stapled zines and reflecting a hand-painted eye sign from across the street, a crow on the sill and a bicycle leaning below, the glass also reflecting a man in plaid flannel seen from behind with an old three-legged dog, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
